definition: Same original photographic capture, including resized, compressed, rotated, color-processed, or cropped versions.
minimum_evidence: Distinctive capture-specific visual correspondence; explain lesion-internal detail and spatially consistent surrounding landmarks where visible. A severe crop requires multiple distinctive remaining correspondences.
insufficient_or_misleading_evidence: Similar diagnosis, color, broad morphology, filename, hash, similarity score, or AI label alone; an unexplained difference that could be a new capture.
reviewer_must_record: Decision; confidence; visible corresponding landmarks; transformation explanation; limitations; reviewer ID and UTC time.
handling_implication: Link as one photo identity for leakage prevention. No relabeling or automatic exclusion.
second_reviewer_or_adjudicator: Two independent reviewers required. Any disagreement, LOW confidence, or weak rationale requires adjudicator review; otherwise retain UNCERTAIN.

definition: Separate photographic captures of the same physical lesion.
minimum_evidence: Convincing lesion-specific correspondence plus evidence that these are separate captures, not transformations of one photograph.
insufficient_or_misleading_evidence: Same diagnosis, lesion-type label, color, body region, general morphology, unverified lesion ID, or crop difference alone.
reviewer_must_record: Decision; confidence; lesion-specific correspondence; evidence of separate captures; limitations; reviewer ID and UTC time.
handling_implication: Keep linked as the same lesion for split grouping. Does not establish patient identity or authorize relabeling.
second_reviewer_or_adjudicator: Two independent reviewers required. Disagreement or LOW confidence requires adjudicator review; unresolved cases remain UNCERTAIN.

definition: Sufficiently supported different photographs and different lesions.
minimum_evidence: Lesion-specific differences not reasonably explained by crop, orientation, lighting, scale, compression, or quality; rationale supports distinct lesion identities.
insufficient_or_misleading_evidence: Different framing, color, lighting, quality, filenames, failed automated match, or absence of metadata alone.
reviewer_must_record: Decision; confidence; distinguishing visible evidence; why same-lesion relation is unsupported; limitations; reviewer ID and UTC time.
handling_implication: No duplicate/lesion link is established by this pair review only; does not prove patient independence or clear other relations.
second_reviewer_or_adjudicator: Two independent reviewers required. Disagreement, weak rationale, or LOW confidence requires adjudicator review or UNCERTAIN.

definition: Evidence cannot reliably resolve the image relationship.
minimum_evidence: Record the ambiguity, conflicting evidence, or missing visual context and plausible alternatives.
insufficient_or_misleading_evidence: Using an AI result, similarity score, source label, or majority preference to force a category.
reviewer_must_record: Decision; confidence; uncertainty reason; limitations; reviewer ID and UTC time.
handling_implication: Quarantine from final split approval until resolved; do not separate across partitions while unresolved.
second_reviewer_or_adjudicator: Two independent reviewers required. Preserve UNCERTAIN if both agree; disagreements go to an adjudicator, who must not force a category.

definition: At least one file is missing, unreadable, corrupted, inaccessible, or otherwise unsuitable for comparison.
minimum_evidence: Identify the affected side and concrete access or quality limitation; record confidence that comparison is not possible.
insufficient_or_misleading_evidence: Treating missing/unreadable content as DISTINCT or inferring content from metadata, filename, path, or hash.
reviewer_must_record: Decision; confidence in non-comparability; affected side; concrete reason; reviewer ID and UTC time.
handling_implication: Quarantine from final split approval until resolved or separately excluded with documented, authorized justification.
second_reviewer_or_adjudicator: Two independent reviewers where feasible. Any disagreement requires adjudication; preserve NOT_COMPARABLE if the limitation remains.
